$(window).load(function () {
	
	var my_range = $(".js-range-slider").data("ionRangeSlider");
     $(".js-range-slider").ionRangeSlider({
            type: "double",
	        min: 0,
	        max: 10000,
	        from: 200,
	        to: 5000,
	        grid: false,
	        prefix: "&#8381;",
	        skin: "round",
	        onStart: function(data) {
            $('input[name=sum_ot]').val(data.from);
            $('input[name=sum_do]').val(data.to);

             },
            onChange: function(data) {
            $('input[name=sum_ot]').val(data.from);
            $('input[name=sum_do]').val(data.to);
             }
    });
      ////////


$('input[name=sum_ot],input[name=sum_do]').bind("change paste keyup", function()  { 
	$(".js-range-slider").data("ionRangeSlider").update({
        from: $('input[name=sum_ot]').val(),
        to: $('input[name=sum_do]').val()
    });
});



});
